Diphthongs

Two vowel sounds inside one syllable.

The rule

2 vowels  /  1 single syllable
Three words. Three diphthongs.
node · site · gate
Why this is hard for a French person: French vowels hold still. They start somewhere and stay there. English keeps moving.

1 · The mirror test

let  →  late

Watch your lower jaw. On let it stays where it is. On late it should move upward, a small amount, while you are still saying the vowel.

let late  ·  pen pain  ·  test taste  ·  get gate

hop  →  hope

On hope the jaw moves forward, and the lips round as it goes.

hop hope  ·  not note  ·  cost coast  ·  rod road

2 · The eight sounds

The right-hand column is the useful part: most of the time you can tell from the spelling alone.

the Aday Spain main gain gate · ay, ai, ei, ey, and a + consonant + silent e
the Ichild find high bias site · igh, and i + consonant + silent e
the Ono road diode download node · oa, and o + consonant + silent e
OYboy noise choice coil · oi, oy
OWhouse down power ground · ow, ou
AIRchair care where square · ai, a, e + r + silent e
EARbeer hear appear series · ea, ee + r
SUREsure poor secure tour · u + r
One word with two of them. diode is the I and then the O, in two syllables, back to back: DY-ode.

3 · The maze

Your own vocabulary, laid out in a grid. Start on DIODE, get to GROUND. One step at a time, up, down, left or right, never diagonally, and you may only stand on a word that glides.

 

4 · Say it

In each, one has the same vowel as the word on the left. Tap to hear.

say = rain
choice = noise
show = goal
nine = fight
here = near
hair = there
sure = pure
cow = shout

Now out loud, slowly, watching the jaw move.
